entries.0693b93e4016c3d2: It manufactures and sells containers mainly made from paper. Mainly 5 consolidated subsidiaries, including Tokan Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Nihon Tokan Package Co., Ltd. and 3 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of corrugated cardboard products for beverages declined, but prices were revised and sales of lunch containers for convenience stores and beverage cups for fast food increased, so sales exceeded the prior year.
entries.1609ed4f774e03f1: A business that leases office buildings, commercial facilities and others. The company and 12 consolidated subsidiaries, including Tokan Kyoei Co., Ltd. and 11 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥8,332 million (up 3.1% year on year), mainly rental income.
entries.4d0ec9b729cacd21: Machinery and equipment related to packaging containers
entries.5640fac6d4f899e6: A business that manufactures and sells steel sheets and their processed products. Mainly 7 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Kohan Co., Ltd. and 6 others, and 1 equity-method affiliate are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥91,463 million (up 1.6% year on year). For electrical and electronic components, secondary battery materials for automotive use increased, and for construction and home appliances, interior materials for unit baths increased, while for automotive and industrial machinery components, drivetrain component materials declined. Can materials were in line with the prior year, as materials for 18-liter cans declined while those for food cans increased.
entries.652beed5bace82d2: A business that manufactures and sells machinery and equipment for making containers, provides contract manufacturing and sales (filling) of beverages and aerosol products, and operates trucking and warehousing. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥179,344 million (up 22.5% year on year). Higher sales of can-making and can-lid-making machines to new customers, the consolidation of PREMIER CENTRE GROUP SDN. BHD., which runs home care and personal care product filling operations in Malaysia, and increased beverage filling in Thailand pushed up sales.
entries.7f05929cebd26851: It manufactures and sells containers mainly made from metal. Mainly 12 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Seikan Co., Ltd. and Nippon Closure Co., Ltd. and 10 others, and 3 equity-method affiliates are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, prices were revised in Japan and overseas, but sales volumes of empty cans and can lids for alcoholic beverages in Japan declined, so sales were in line with the prior year.
entries.7fd65e05a0773969: A category of businesses not included in reportable segments, including the manufacture and sale of automotive press dies, machinery and equipment, hard alloys and agricultural materials products, the sale of petroleum products, and non-life insurance agency business, among others. Mainly 9 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥23,989 million (up 1.1% year on year). Although larger than the Real Estate Business, it is placed last because it is a category not included in reportable segments.
entries.8606cac8da8ec1c4: It manufactures and sells containers mainly made from glass. Mainly 5 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Glass Co., Ltd. and 4 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, prices were revised, but sales of bottled products for soft drinks declined, so sales were in line with the prior year.
entries.91a0b20f6535ada4: It manufactures and sells machinery and equipment related to packaging containers. Mainly 16 consolidated subsidiaries, including Stolle Machinery Company, LLC, Toyo Seikan Group Engineering, Ltd. and 14 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, capital spending restraint continued among existing customers, but sales of can-making and can-lid-making machines to new customers increased, and sales significantly exceeded the prior year.
entries.a775da2975a09bbe: A business that manufactures and sells functional materials, including aluminum substrates for magnetic disks, optical functional films, glazes, pigments, gel coats and trace-element fertilizers. Mainly 10 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Kohan Co., Ltd., TOMATEC Co., Ltd. and 8 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥57,785 million (up 11.4% year on year). Market conditions recovered for hard disk applications for data centers, and aluminum substrates for magnetic disks increased. Optical functional films declined due to the impact of deteriorating market conditions for flat panel displays.
entries.c768781dccbb5e45: Contract manufacturing and sales of beverage filling, aerosol products and general filling. Mainly 9 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Aerosol Industry Co., Ltd., Toyo Seikan (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and 7 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, PREMIER CENTRE GROUP SDN. BHD. of Malaysia was consolidated, and beverage filling in Thailand increased, so sales significantly exceeded the prior year.
entries.ca9ca9240c25a5a1: A comprehensive container manufacturer centered on containers of metal, plastic, paper and glass, which also handles can-making machinery, steel sheets and functional materials.
entries.cf551ef86966e4b5: A business that makes and sells containers made mainly from metal, plastic, paper and glass, centered on cans, bottles, caps, cups and jars used for beverages and food. Toyo Seikan Co., Ltd., Nippon Closure Co., Ltd., Tokan Kogyo Co., Ltd., Mebius Packaging Co., Ltd., Nihon Tokan Package Co., Ltd., Toyo Glass Co., Ltd. and others are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥602,297 million (down 0.0% year on year), the largest of the reportable segments. Prices were revised, but sales volumes of empty cans and can lids for alcoholic beverages in Japan declined, so sales were in line with the prior year.
entries.e749a020b27bf246: It manufactures and sells containers mainly made from plastic. Mainly 13 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Seikan Co., Ltd., Tokan Kogyo Co., Ltd., Nippon Closure Co., Ltd. and Mebius Packaging Co., Ltd. and 9 others, and 2 equity-method affiliates are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of small PET bottles and preforms for beverages declined, but prices were revised and sales of resin cups for beverages and bottles for oral care increased, so sales were in line with the prior year.
entries.e9634bbed219d226: Secondary battery materials for automotive use
entries.f6ce72323183a777: Trucking and warehousing, among others. Mainly 5 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Mebius Co., Ltd. and 4 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales exceeded the prior year.
